what: Two 20px corner brackets hang 5px outside the top-left and bottom-right of the outlined button. On hover the brackets grow in .3s ease-in-out to 10px larger than the button and wrap all of it, while at the same time the background fills with the line color in .3s ease-out and the text (and the currentColor arrow) turns white. Reverses on release.

options.--fx-dur: Length the bracket grows (via style), default .3s
options.--fx-fill-dur: Duration of the background and text color change (via style), default .3s
options.--fx-tick: Bracket side length (via style), default 20px — original on phone 15px
options.--fx-gap: Distance the brackets extend outside the button (set via style), default 5px
options.--fx-line·--fx-base·--fx-ink: Line (including brackets)·default background·default text color, defaults --kf-accent·--kf-surface·--kf-accent
options.--fx-fill·--fx-on: Hover background and hover text color, default --kf-accent and --kf-on-accent

note: Uses CSS only (since ::before and ::after are used as brackets, the element’s own ::before and ::after are left empty — the arrow goes in an inner span). On devices without hover, the brackets and fill don’t move.

from.where: shared.css .ot-lbtn (footer ”See other stores” — original layout.css .l-button: :before and :after 20px by 1px, width/height .3s ease-in-out → calc(100% + 10px), color and background .3s ease-out, 15px on phones)
